name: Bristol Parks and Recreation Summer Camp
street_address: Bristol Town Beach & Sports Complex, 50 Asylum Rd.
description_short: A six week town day camp for Bristol children at the Town Beach and Sports Complex, with lunch and bus pickup from neighborhood parks included in the fee.
notes: Bristol residents only. Fee is $300 per camper for the whole summer, $250 per sibling, and includes lunch and busing if needed. Hours 9 am to 3 pm; no camp July 3. Bus stops: Town Common, Vets Park, Coelho Park, Sowams Park, Cedarcrest Park and Rockwell School. Rain location: Quinta-Gamelin Community Center, 101 Asylum Road. Photos on the page call it Camp Poppasquaw.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Camp 2026 section: dates, 9 am to 3 pm, Bristol residents only ages 6 to 14 (age 6 by June 29), $300 per camper or $250 per sibling including lunch and busing; zip from the town hall address in the page footer

for_andrew: Open to Bristol residents only and the page posts no non-resident rate, so the house rule (list the non-resident rate) cannot apply. List a residents only camp, or leave it out?
Only the 2026 season is posted (it ended August 7); 2027 dates and fee are not up yet.
